method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (loa-core.l4) with three regulative rules (commencing the action within the time limited; s 45A(1) notice within 6 years; s 45A(5) suing within 6 months of the defendant's notice) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the person bringing the action) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, dates or numbers, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation of Actions Act 1936 (SA), the register's current version 1.7.2021 (the version the Current Titles list of 22 September 2026 gave), as the unauthorised RTF fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 and deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/limitation-of-actions-act-1936.txt (sha256 8d055dc9289812f5ac8e03bcd13a7c989e7bc4eed2b4e6c0f99aebafbd06d3d8 as committed), with the transitional provisions printed in its legislative history (Limitation of Actions (Child Abuse) Amendment Act 2018 Sch 1; Defamation Act 2005 Sch 1 cl 8; Defamation (Miscellaneous) Amendment Act 2020 Sch 1 cl 5). Not the authorised PDF. No regulations set numbers the encoded sections use (the s 45A(3) notice contents are by regulation and are out).

seat: the person entitled to bring the action: the injured person (or the person abused as a child), the person defamed, the person owed money or a legacy, the payer of an invalid tax, the executor suing for an estate (loa-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run loa-dates.l4 ; l4 run loa-core.l4 ; l4 run loa-seat.l4 ; l4 run loa-cases.l4
checks.result: 138 assertions written, 138 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (the s 45(3) cap 360 to 361 months, the s 37(2) window 55 to 54 days) failed exactly the 3 predicted assertions and was reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
